single_axis_source: LOCAL v4.12 Rev.3 article 39: ASI 49 or less forbids single axis
selection_formula: main=observed eligible role-score maxima; additional if leader-score <= score_span * max(column_AKI, axis risk for W or RSI for P2/P3)/100; risk is max not sum
missing_policy: No neutral observation is eligibility support. Information uncertainty reported separately; no fabricated axis or role floor. PAPER regardless of compatible capital.
pair_policy: Distinct head and second; observed head position and observed second acquisition/maintenance; PROTECT model relation only. No exact order purchase confidence claimed.
third_policy: Distinct triple; observed third progression/maintenance is pair-context PROTECT. R3 global P3 tail continuity remains.
capital_policy: Run existing R3 and capital after immutable selection. No role pruning, cap or budget input. PAPER/NO_BET only.
venue_policy: All LOCAL flat venues share implementation. No numeric venue coefficients invented. Current venue rules remain upstream evidence/compiler and R3 closure; per-venue empirical validation pending. BAN rejected.

external_change.action: record source revisions; source/universe change invalidates selection, recompute; never infer unchanged from missing

firm_finish_correction.action: not subtracted; missing != zero proven correction

validation.future_plan: Freeze code/policy/input hashes before post; collect all consecutive eligible LOCAL races and holds; 30 eligible races is review trigger only, not automatic promotion. Stratify venue/field/class/distance/going; chronological design/evaluation separation; same-source frozen production comparator; no payoff tuning.
metrics: equal-budget/count linear normalization explicitly not reselection
validation.probability_calibration: NONE; scores and AKI are not probabilities or EV

structural_anchor_rule: If W has exactly one supported head, exclude it from P2/P3 anchor pools; if P2 also has exactly one supported second, exclude it from P3 anchor pool. Choose maxima only from remaining eligible observations; no fixed rank floor.
